datasets.name: Semi-automatic and manual shallow landslide inventories
datasets.verbatim: ML and PL datasets used in this study are available in KML format on the Zenodo platform: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8164752 (Notti et al., 2022).

methods.name: Two-phase semi-automatic methodology for shallow landslide mapping
methods.summary: A two-phase procedure using Sentinel-2 imagery and Google Earth Engine. The first phase uses pre- and post-event NDVI variation and geomorphological filtering (slope) to extract potential shallow landslides (PLs). The second phase involves comparing the semi-automatic inventory with a benchmark manual inventory to refine parameters and validate the results.
methods.verbatim: Also all the Google Earth Engine scripts are stored in the same dataset (PDF File) on Zenodo. ... ML and PL datasets used in this study are available in KML format on the Zenodo platform: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8164752 (Notti et al., 2022).
